commands.name: ABOUT
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1: shows Epiora version info; no numeric effect. Proposed v1.1 addition.

commands.name: ALWAYS
commands.reason: Check-code block that runs on every record; ships with the check-code engine (v1.3).

commands.name: ASSIGN
commands.reason: Spec §5.3. The DLL call form (var = class!method(...)) is not planned: COM/.NET interop, Windows-only. Also a check-code command (v1.3).

commands.name: AUTOSEARCH
commands.reason: Record autosearch during data entry.

commands.name: BEEP
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1. Also a check-code command (v1.3).

commands.name: CALL
commands.reason: Invokes a CMD/SUB block; Classic Analysis subroutine support is deferred to the parity milestone pending corpus evidence. Check-code CALL ships with v1.3.

commands.name: CANCEL READ
commands.reason: Spec §5.3 names it; it is not a grammar keyword (Epi Info 7 has only CANCEL SELECT / CANCEL SORT). Closes the working view and discards the recipe. Proposed v1.1 addition.

commands.name: CANCEL SELECT
commands.reason: Spec §5.3.

commands.name: CANCEL SORT
commands.reason: Spec §5.3.

commands.name: CLEAR
commands.reason: Clears an entered value during data entry.

commands.name: CLOSEOUT
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1: output file close is recorded, not reproduced.

commands.name: CMD
commands.reason: User-defined command block (CMD…END / END-CMD); deferred with CALL/SUB.

commands.name: COMMANDLINE
commands.reason: Executes Epi Info menu-command (.mnu) program blocks; Epiora has no menu-command system. No Rule class exists at this commit.

commands.name: CONNECTION
commands.reason: DEFINE CONNECTION: arbitrary database connection strings need a general connector feature; the roadmap places connectors at v2.2.

commands.name: COXPH
commands.reason: Cox proportional hazards; v1.5 survival.

commands.name: DEFINE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3. DLLOBJECT/NETOBJECT options are not planned (COM/.NET interop); GROUPVAR is deferred to v1.6 with LIST grouping. Also a check-code command (v1.3).

commands.name: DEFINEVARIABLES
commands.reason: Check-code variable block.

commands.name: DELETE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3: records from the working view and variables. DELETE File and DELETE TABLES are not planned: Epiora never deletes source files or tables.

commands.name: DIALOG
commands.reason: Interactive prompts inside a program run need the editor's run-time input UI. Check-code DIALOG ships at v1.3.

commands.name: DISABLE
commands.reason: Disable a field during entry.

commands.name: DISPLAY
commands.reason: Spec §5.3: variables, datasets or the recipe.

commands.name: ENABLE
commands.reason: Enable a field during entry.

commands.name: EXECUTE
commands.reason: Launches OS processes or URLs from a program — impossible in the web app and not placed on the roadmap; a desktop-only candidate post-1.6.

commands.name: EXIT
commands.reason: Ends the program run (like QUIT). No Rule class at this commit — parses but is not executed in the open-source build. Proposed v1.1 addition. Check-code Exit at v1.3.

commands.name: FIELD
commands.reason: Check-code per-field block.

commands.name: FILEDIALOG
commands.reason: File picker inside a program run. No Rule class at this commit. Check-code use at v1.3.

commands.name: FORM
commands.reason: Check-code per-form block (alias of VIEW).

commands.name: FREQ
commands.reason: Shipped at v1.0; runs on the working view at v1.1. PSUVAR waits for complex samples (v1.5).

commands.name: GEOCODE
commands.reason: Address geocoding during entry; no geocoder is on the platform roadmap.

commands.name: GETPATH
commands.reason: Reads a path during entry.

commands.name: GOTO
commands.reason: Move to a field or page during entry (skip logic).

commands.name: GOTOFORM
commands.reason: Move to a related form during entry.

commands.name: GOTOPAGE
commands.reason: Move to a page during entry.

commands.name: GRAPH
commands.reason: Graphs and epi curves; v1.4.

commands.name: HEADER
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1.

commands.name: HELP
commands.reason: Show a help file during entry.

commands.name: HIDE
commands.reason: Hide fields during entry.

commands.name: HIGHLIGHT
commands.reason: Highlight fields during entry.

commands.name: IF
commands.reason: Spec §5.3 conditional cleaning commands. Check-code IF…END-IF (with ELSE-IF) ships at v1.3.

commands.name: IOCODE
commands.reason: I/O-board hardware coding (legacy Epi Info field hardware); not on the roadmap.

commands.name: KEYVARS
commands.reason: Spec §5.3 names it as the key declaration for MERGE/RELATE; in the grammar keys are inline per command (<KeyDef>, and KEYVARS= only as a LOGISTIC OUTTABLE option). Implemented as the session key declaration. Proposed v1.1 addition.

commands.name: KMSURVIVAL
commands.reason: Kaplan–Meier survival; v1.5.

commands.name: LET
commands.reason: Synonym of ASSIGN. Also a check-code command (v1.3).

commands.name: LIST
commands.reason: Spec §5.3. UPDATE (write-back editing) and the HTML layout options are deferred: update needs entry (v1.3), the HTML options belong to v1.6 reports.

commands.name: LOGISTIC
commands.reason: Logistic regression; v1.2.

commands.name: MAP
commands.reason: Map tables for the Map module; no Rule class exists at this commit (the grammar accepts it, but execution lived outside the interpreter). Lands with v1.4 maps.

commands.name: MATCH
commands.reason: Matched case–control tables; not named on the roadmap — placed at the v1.6 parity milestone.

commands.name: MEANS
commands.reason: Shipped at v1.0; runs on the working view at v1.1.

commands.name: MERGE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3 join in update and append modes. FILESPEC (raw text files) is deferred.

commands.name: NEWPAGE
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1; no Rule class exists at this commit.

commands.name: NEWRECORD
commands.reason: New record during entry.

commands.name: PAGE
commands.reason: Check-code per-page block.

commands.name: PRINTOUT
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1.

commands.name: PYTHON
commands.reason: PYTHON…END-PYTHON embeds a CPython engine in Epi Info 7.2; not on the platform roadmap.

commands.name: QUIT
commands.reason: Ends the program run. Proposed v1.1 addition. Check-code Quit (end entry) at v1.3.

commands.name: R
commands.reason: R…END-R runs an external R engine inside a program; not on the roadmap. Epiora's verified R export is a separate feature.

commands.name: READ
commands.reason: Spec §5.3. File-spec forms for raw text/Excel and SQL/ODBC sources are not planned: arbitrary file and database sources need a connector feature.

commands.name: RECODE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3.

commands.name: RECORD
commands.reason: Check-code per-record block.

commands.name: RECORDSET
commands.reason: Raw recordset block over a database connection; needs a general connector feature (v2.2).

commands.name: REGRESS
commands.reason: Linear regression; v1.2.

commands.name: RELATE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3.

commands.name: REPORT
commands.reason: Report file display and printing; Typst reports are v1.6.

commands.name: ROUTEOUT
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1: output file routing is recorded, not reproduced.

commands.name: RUNPGM
commands.reason: Runs programs saved inside imported projects and .pgm files (spec §6.1 sources). Proposed v1.1 addition.

commands.name: SAVE-RECORD
commands.reason: Save the current record during entry.

commands.name: SELECT
commands.reason: Spec §5.3; repeated SELECTs combine with AND. Bare SELECT re-selects all.

commands.name: SET
commands.reason: Spec §5.3: options that change results. The rest (SHOWPROMPTS, HYPERLINKS, USEOPTIONSTEXT, FREQGRAPH, USEBROWSER, SELECT, TABLES, PYTHONPATH, IGNORE, Boolean=string) are recorded as notes.

commands.name: SET-NOT-REQUIRED
commands.reason: Clear a field's required flag during entry.

commands.name: SET-REQUIRED
commands.reason: Set a field's required flag during entry.

commands.name: SORT
commands.reason: Spec §5.3.

commands.name: SQLEXEC
commands.reason: Direct SQL execution over a database connection; needs a general connector feature (v2.2).

commands.name: SUB
commands.reason: SUB…END-SUB subroutine blocks; deferred with CALL/CMD. Check-code SUB ships at v1.3.

commands.name: SUMMARIZE
commands.reason: Aggregates the working view into a new dataset; proposed v1.1 addition — needs no later feature.

commands.name: SYSINFO
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1; no Rule class exists at this commit.

commands.name: TABLES
commands.reason: Shipped at v1.0; runs on the working view at v1.1. PSUVAR waits for complex samples (v1.5).

commands.name: TYPEOUT
commands.reason: Note-only per spec §6.1.

commands.name: UNDEFINE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3 (DEFINE/UNDEFINE). Also a check-code command (v1.3).

commands.name: UNDELETE
commands.reason: Restores working-view records deleted in the session; proposed v1.1 addition — the counterpart of DELETE and SET DELETED.

commands.name: UNHIDE
commands.reason: Unhide fields during entry.

commands.name: UNHIGHLIGHT
commands.reason: Remove highlight during entry.

commands.name: VIEW
commands.reason: Check-code per-view block.

commands.name: WAITFOR
commands.reason: Waits on an external process or file — part of the EXECUTE feature set; not planned.

commands.name: WAITFOREXIT
commands.reason: See WAITFOR.

commands.name: WAITFORFILEEXISTS
commands.reason: See WAITFOR.

commands.name: WRITE
commands.reason: Spec §5.3: materialises the working view as a new dataset version.

functions.name: CURRENTUSER
functions.reason: Identity of the user entering data.

functions.name: ENVIRON
functions.reason: Reads a host environment variable in Epi Info; resolved from a map captured into the recipe at session start (spec §5.3 as-of rule) — the engine never reads a live environment. Exact surface is a Task 10 method choice.

functions.name: EXISTS
functions.reason: File-presence test in Epi Info; resolved from values captured into the recipe at session start, never live I/O in the engine. Exact surface is a Task 10 method choice.

functions.name: FILEDATE
functions.reason: File-modified date in Epi Info; resolved like EXISTS — captured recipe values, never live I/O.

functions.name: GETCOORDINATES
functions.reason: Address geocoding during entry; no geocoder is on the platform roadmap.

functions.name: GROUPROWINDEX
functions.reason: Running index within equal group values of the working view.

functions.name: LAGVALUE
functions.reason: Value on the previous working-view row.

functions.name: LINEBREAK
functions.reason: Inserts a line break in entry-time text.

functions.name: RECORDCOUNT
functions.reason: Position of the current record in the working view.

functions.name: RND
functions.reason: Seeded; the seed is recorded in the recipe (spec §7.4).

functions.name: SENDSMS
functions.reason: Sends SMS from check code; messaging is a Phase-3 feature (v3.0 alerts) — beyond the parity horizon.

functions.name: SYSALTITUDE
functions.reason: GPS altitude during entry; GPS field capture is v2.4 on the roadmap — beyond the parity horizon.

functions.name: SYSBARCODE
functions.reason: Barcode capture during entry; barcode fields are v2.4 on the roadmap — beyond the parity horizon.

functions.name: SYSLATITUDE
functions.reason: GPS latitude during entry; GPS field capture is v2.4 — beyond the parity horizon.

functions.name: SYSLONGITUDE
functions.reason: GPS longitude during entry; GPS field capture is v2.4 — beyond the parity horizon.

functions.name: SYSTEMDATE
functions.reason: The recipe's as-of date per spec §5.3 — no clock in the engine.

functions.name: SYSTEMTIME
functions.reason: The recipe's as-of time per spec §5.3 — no clock in the engine.

modules.feature: Record entry, edit and browse across pages
Projects, views and pages editing (Form Designer)
All field types incl. code tables (Legal Values, Comment Legal, Codes, Option)
Gadget charts (line, bar, pie, scatter) with linked filters
All StatCalc calculators (unmatched and matched case-control, cohort, sample size, chi-square, Poisson, binomial, trend, screening)
